item.title: Partial Outage of DRACOON Cloud [postmortem]
item.description:
We experienced an issue with DRACOON Cloud on 2026-07-16 from around 00:05 to 00:30 CEST. Our team has worked diligently to identify the root cause and implement a resolution. In this post-mortem, we want to share the details of what happened, why it happened, what we did to resolve it, and what we will do to prevent similar incidents in the future.
‌
**What happened?**
Our datacenter provider experienced availability issues in a region and availability zone, where some our DRACOON Cloud infrastructure is running. As a result of that, parts of DRACOON Cloud were unavailable or had degraded performance during the time of the incident.
‌
**What did we do?**
Our engineers analyzed the situation and applied a technical workaround to fully restore availability as fast as possible.
‌
